extract_video_pts: extract presentation timestamps from a video file using ffprobe and save to frames.txt
extract_video_frames: extract all frames from a video file as PNG images using ffmpeg
downscale_video_frames: downscale extracted video frames to a smaller size with optional channel swizzle
check_video_frames: verify that the expected number of frame files exist in a directory
sample_frame_pairs: sample frame pairs from a given frame range using specified sampling modes
